newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt yields steady after initial drop.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt yields steady after initial drop.

text.p: Swedish debt yields were stable in late Wednesday morning trade after dropping a few basis points at opening.
Firmer U.S. Treasuries were leading the way but dealers saw little prospect for a further fall today.
"Players are waiting for the bond auction today and the U.S. Fed-meeting. I dont think we will see the nine-year bond below 7.25 today," said one dealer.
At 1020 GMT, nine-year bond yields were down three basis points to 7.28 percent while six-month T-bills had shaved off one basis point to 4.48 percent.
The National Debt Office is offering two billion crowns in five-year bonds at today's auction with solid bidding expected.
"It think investors still have some appetite for bonds, despite last day's falling yields," said one dealer.
The crown tailed a stronger dollar but could not escape a tight trading range. Currency dealers saw the crown's upside capped at 4.40 crowns to the mark with the bottom 4.4250.
"We need some new positive information to take us out of this area", said one dealer. The mark eased to 4.4030 crowns from 4.4165 crowns late Wednesday.
